title: Host uniform struct stores selection background before foreground while the shader's std140 block declares foreground first
expected_finding: Globals.iSelectionForegroundColor is at offset 4464 and iSelectionBackgroundColor at 4480, but the host Uniforms struct copied into the buffer has selection_background_color at 4464 and selection_foreground_color at 4480, so the shader reads each selection colour from the other's slot
